purpose: Teach: ゴージャス/重荷/土星/母乳/モザイク/軍艦/パジャマ/タマネギ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゴージャスなドレスでお見えになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer came in wearing the most gorgeous dress today.
lines.style: Warm, approving observation. Soft smile in the voice. Natural pace, almost conversational — sharing something noticed with a friend.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様の世話が重荷だって愚痴られてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she was actually complaining about how heavy the childcare feels sometimes.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful tone. A slight pause before diving in — choosing words carefully. Quiet understanding, not gossip.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、土星のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she was telling me all about Saturn the other day.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Slight lilt of interest — the detail of what the customer shared. Unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、母乳育児のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she was talking about her experience with breastfeeding.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. No rush. The kind of tone that honors a personal confidence. Matter-of-fact but tender.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、モザイクアートを習ってらっしゃるんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, it sounds like she's been taking mosaic art classes.
lines.style: Interested, encouraging inflection. A soft brightness — appreciating the customer's creative side. Natural, conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、軍艦のプラモデル作りがご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, building battleship models is actually her hobby, you know.
lines.style: Slightly surprised warmth. The reveal of something unexpected about the customer. Gentle rhythm, like sharing a nice secret.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、パジャマ姿でうたた寝してらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, her little one was dozing off in their pajamas earlier — so peaceful.
lines.style: Soft, almost fond. The warmth of witnessing something small and innocent. Quiet contentment throughout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、タマネギスープ加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's add an onion soup option to the new menu, don't you think?
lines.style: Bright, collaborative energy. Light enthusiasm building toward the suggestion. Warm at the close — inviting her to be part of the idea.
